series_label: Antenatal care 4+ visits - percentage of women (aged 15-49 years) attended at least four times during pregnancy by any provider (Nigeria, total: sex _T, age Y15T49, wealth quintile _T, residence _T)
source_or_custodian: UNICEF data warehouse (SDMX), dataflow UNICEF/MNCH/1.0. Each year comes from a different survey source code: MNCH_SRC_393 (2003), MNCH_SRC_310 (2008), MNCH_SRC_267 (2011), MNCH_SRC_751 (2013), MNCH_SRC_1608 (2017), MNCH_SRC_455 (2018), MNCH_SRC_2566 (2021), MNCH_SRC_2923 (2024, source link 'CRAVE 2024'). The server did not name the surveys or the custodian.
status_or_notes: Only these 8 survey years have data in 2000-2025. All other years, including 2000-2002, 2004-2007, 2009-2010, 2012, 2014-2016, 2019-2020, 2022-2023 and 2025, have no observation. OBS_STATUS is RP for all values. LOWER_BOUND and UPPER_BOUND are empty. The tool reported 'not_a_single_series' because the series mixes data sources, so values are one observation per year across those sources.
definition: Percentage of women (aged 15-49 years) attended at least four times during pregnancy by any provider
